ordered_branches.explanation: First result left LOT by item/lot/NULL-equal company without warehouse; left shipment; left ITEM admits matching company or any generic NULL-company item. Serial marker depends on ITEM.SERIAL_NUM_TRACKING>=4, not actual serial rows. Recursive CTE includes selected container and descendants for work-count membership with coded condition/type filters. Transaction join matches container ID, shipment business ID and warehouse. Last counts use immediate parent only and separately coded type equality/inequality.

program.text: CASE WHEN I.SERIAL_NUM_TRACKING >= 4 THEN N'<literal:3>' ELSE N'<literal:4>' END AS HasSerialNumbers,
left outer join LOT l ON SC.ITEM = l.ITEM AND SC.LOT = l.LOT AND ((SC.COMPANY IS NULL AND l.COMPANY IS NULL) OR SC.COMPANY = l.COMPANY)
left outer join SHIPMENT_HEADER sh on sc.INTERNAL_SHIPMENT_NUM = sh.INTERNAL_SHIPMENT_NUM
ON (sc.ITEM = i.ITEM AND (sc.COMPANY = i.COMPANY OR (sc.COMPANY IS NULL AND i.COMPANY IS NULL) OR (i.COMPANY IS NULL))) -- [comment omitted]
FROM WORK_INSTRUCTION WI WHERE CONDITION <> N'<literal:6>'

limitations: This is the retained 2026-09-29 replica capture, not a new database inspection. NO_CAPTURED_REFERENCE means none of the credited channels in this exact retained corpus identified the table. It does not establish that the table is unused, obsolete, a backup, safe to delete, or absent from external application SQL.

The bounded lexer recognizes named SQL relation/DML positions and local aliases/CTEs; it is not the SQL Server binder. Unqualified names assume a unique captured name, not verified caller/default-schema resolution. Unsupported or ambiguous syntax remains explicit.
